_help: Site-wide news. Newest first is not required (the site sorts by date). tag is one of: site, anyps, anderscraft, vault. url is optional and may be a path on this site. Leave date as "" for an undated note.

items.title: The hub got a big refresh
items.body: Live status chips, a theme switch, controller navigation, a news ticker and a lot of polish across every page.

items.title: AnyPS V1.05.1 is out
items.body: A snappier in-game overlay, PS3 memory tools fixed, and a saved-values list with stay-on mods.

items.title: AnyPS now has a 32-bit Windows edition
items.body: A small PSP-only build for older 32-bit PCs.

items.title: AnyPS V1.05: one-press updates
items.body: AnyPS can now update itself in place and keeps your games, saves and sign-ins. Also a redesigned start-up screen.

items.title: AnyPS V1.04: PS Vita joins the shelf
items.body: PlayStation Vita support, memory tools, save states and checkpoints, a save vault and smart lists.

items.title: AnyPS V1.03
items.body: Mass install, a set-up wizard, a cheats manager, PS3 online accounts inside AnyPS and the first self-updater.

items.title: AnyPS V1.02
items.body: User profiles, collections, tutorials, a visual controller remap and game backgrounds, music and video.

items.title: AnyPS V1.0 released
items.body: The first public build of the launcher.

items.title: Choose your avenue
items.body: The site became a hub for AndersCraft, AnyPS and the Personal Vault.

items.title: AndersCraft sign-ups are open
items.body: Create a game account right from the website.

items.title: Level cap raised to 125
items.body: The journey keeps going after 80, with combat tuned for the new levels.

items.title: Quality-of-life pack
items.body: Transmog, account-wide mounts, dungeons that scale to your group, cross-faction battlegrounds, a bigger bank, Mythic+ and a stocked auction house.
